description.value: Winning Trading Co is a Vancouver-based wholesale distributor supplying sushi restaurants and other food service businesses with frozen seafood, dry goods, paper products, and cleaning supplies. Operating out of a two-storey building in the Grandview-Woodland neighbourhood near Venables Street, it serves the Lower Mainland's Japanese restaurant industry. Access appears trade-only, so a touring cyclist stopping by would find a commercial loading environment rather than a retail shop floor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is a wholesale restaurant supply company (frozen seafood, paper products, cleaning supplies) at 1568 Venables Street, matching the OSM address and phone. The OSM tag wholesale=restaurant corroborates the website description. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so all amenity fields are null. The category 'Groceries' is a loose match via shop=wholesale, but this is a B2B trade supplier rather than a public-facing retail grocery.
concerns: Business is a wholesale-only restaurant supplier (wholesale=restaurant OSM tag; website confirms B2B focus) — category 'Groceries' is misleading for a public-facing directory; individual retail sales to cyclists appear unlikely.
Several subpages (/dry_products.html, /paper_products.html, /supplies.html, /containers.html) return 404, suggesting the website content is partially outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating business at a confirmed physical address with a live website and matching contact details. Included on the basis of general utility, though its wholesale-trade-only nature means cycling tourists will find limited practical services here.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM maps shop=wholesale to Groceries, but the business is a wholesale-only restaurant supply distributor with no evidence of retail public sales. A touring cyclist is unlikely to be able to purchase individual food items here.

wow_evidence: wholesale-trade-only nature means cycling tourists will find limited practical services here
